Responsabilidades Da Posição

Liderar os funcionários : É o gestor que cuida do time de colaboradores, começando por sua estrutura, coordenação, até a administração de toda a equipe. O gerente de pet shop acompanha a rotina individualmente, faz reuniões, busca feedback sobre a sua gestão, treina os funcionários, ensina os processos de cada atividade e integra novos integrantes ao time.

Mantém o cliente fidelizado : Um dos fatores que mais influencia a opinião dos clientes sobre o pet shop é a confiança. O consumidor precisa saber que seu pet é bem tratado, banho e tosa e nas consultas veterinárias, inclusive quando o dono esteja ausente. Algumas ações do gerente podem facilitar a conquista da confiança e, consequentemente, da fidelização do cliente. Cuidar da segurança, contar como é o funcionamento do pet shop para os consumidores, nãó deixar faltar produtos em loja, limpeza, precificação, planograma, gestão de pessoa, escala, fechamento de caixa, planejar promoções e ações de marketing são alguns exemplos.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Sr Golang – Invillia Tecnologia – Home Office
description:
Desenvolvedor Backend Sr Golang – Invillia Tecnologia – Home Office

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do team em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Go em produção, domínio de concorrência (goroutines, channels, context, mutex/atomic) e design de APIs (REST/gRPC).
  • Comunicação assíncrona com Kafka (preferencial), SQS e RabbitMQ (particionamento, ordering, reprocesso, poison messages).
  • AWS no dia a dia (MSK/Kafka, SQS/SNS, RDS Postgres, S3, CloudWatch, IAM; EKS/ECS ou Lambda).
  • Kubernetes e Docker (deploy, health/readiness, autoscaling, config/secret, tolerances/affinity).
  • Observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog/ELK), logs estruturados e correlação.
  • Git e Git-Flow;
  • Bancos de dados: PostgreSQL e NoSQL (ex.: MongoDB/Redis); modelagem transacional, migrations e tuning.
  • Padrões de projeto (Strategy, Factory, Adapter, Observer, Decorator, Proxy) e princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI.
  • Qualidade: testes unitários/integração/contrato, Sonar (métricas/gates).
  • Experiência com microserviços e sistemas concorrentes em larga escala.
  • Continuous Delivery (principalmente GitHub Actions; GitLab CI é bem-vindo).

DIFERENCIAL

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com Node;

title: Product & Delivery Manager
description:
A Mundpay é um gateway de pagamentos focado em simplificar a operação financeira de empresas que vendem online. Atuamos com processamento de pagamentos, gestão de disputas e chargebacks, e integrações com adquirentes e bancos. Somos um time enxuto, técnico e orientado a resultados — cada pessoa aqui tem impacto direto no produto.

Buscamos uma pessoa que seja o elo entre produto, engenharia e negócio. Não é um PO clássico que apenas escreve user stories, nem um gestor de projetos que apenas controla prazos. Precisamos de alguém que faça as duas coisas com propriedade: documenta bem, prioriza com critério, acompanha entregas de perto e cobra resultado.

  • Criar e manter documentos de requisitos (PRDs, user stories, critérios de aceite) para novos produtos e funcionalidades
  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog no ClickUp, garantindo que o time sempre saiba o que é mais importante
  • Definir e acompanhar prazos de entrega junto ao time de engenharia
  • Medir e reportar a produtividade das entregas (cycle time, throughput, taxa de retrabalho)
  • Garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas com as metas de negócio
  • Cobrar entregas com clareza e respeito, removendo bloqueios quando necessário
  • Facilitar alinhamentos entre produto, tech e stakeholders

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência prévia como PO, PM ou analista de produto em empresa de tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão (ClickUp, Jira, Linear ou similares)
  • Capacidade de escrever requisitos claros, objetivos e que o time consiga executar
  • Habilidade de priorização com base em valor de negócio e esforço técnico
  • Perfil orientado a dados: você mede o que entrega
  • Comunicação direta, sem ruído
  • Bonus: conhecimento em fintechs, meios de pagamento ou produtos financeiros

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com métodos de priorização (ICE, RICE, MoSCoW)
  • Noção de arquitetura de sistemas ou APIs (não precisa codar, mas precisa entender)
  • Vivência em times pequenos e de alto crescimento

O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho hibrido - Centro do Rio de Janeiro.
  • Autonomia real: aqui você não só executa, você influencia decisões
  • Time técnico sênior com quem você vai aprender muito
  • Ambiente sem burocracia e com impacto direto no produto

  • Inovação e Melhoria contínua: Olhar curioso e analítico para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, propor soluções criativas e contribuir para a evolução dos processos.

Você vai se destacar se:

  • Mantiver a calma sob pressão;
  • For flexível e colaborativo(a);

Howard University Position Listing

Job Title: Associate Director of Assessment

Location: Howard University

Full/Part Time: Full-Time

Regular/Temporary: Regular

Howard University Mission

Howard University is a comprehensive, research-oriented, historically Black private university providing an educational experience of exceptional quality to students of high academic potential with particular emphasis upon the provision of educational opportunities to promising Black students. Further, the University is dedicated to attracting and sustaining a cadre of faculty who are, through their teaching and research, committed to the development of distinguished and compassionate graduates and to the quest for solutions to human and social problems in the United States and throughout the world.

Position Compensation

Salary Commensurate With Qualifications, Education & University Guidelines.

Basic Function

This position takes a lead role in planning and assessment activities coordinated by Institutional Research & Assessment (IRA), under the Office of the Provost. Specifically, this position coordinates all surveys (external and internal) within IRA and coordinates all technology platforms.

Supervisory Accountability

May be responsible for supervising and directing work of undergraduate and graduate students.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include Deans, Department Chairs, staff, faculty, and students. External contacts include affiliated schools, national research centers, and assessment/student learning organizations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Facilitates engagement in and provides support and direction for the assessment of the general education curriculum.
  • Designs, administers, and analyzes institutional surveys.
  • Supports assessment and accreditation activities across the university through consulting, review, and technical support.
  • Co‑manages assessment platform for the university (Watermark), offering technical support, troubleshooting, updating users, and creating support material for users.
  • Manages course evaluation platform (Course Evaluations & Surveys by Watermark) and coordinates with campus partners regarding its effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Leads the administration, research and reporting related to university survey initiatives such as student engagement (NSSE), faculty survey (FSSE), First‑Year experience (CIRP), Course Evaluations and internal university survey projects administered via Qualtrics.
  • Serves as a central support unit for internal surveys across campus (Qualtrics training, survey consulting, survey creation and distribution for university leadership).
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Working knowledge of the literature on learner‑centered assessment and evaluation, general education, rubrics as an assessment tool, high‑impact educational practices, surveys, response rates, and best practices in higher education assessment.
  • Experience executing a large‑scale project successfully, from conceptualization through completion.
  • Ability to take direction, assume increasingly independent responsibility, and provide appropriate follow‑up on project‑based work.
  • Ability to guide assistant director(s) and coordinator(s) to set deadlines, manage project completion, and develop staff.
  • Possess strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and reporting‑writing skills.
  • Ability to create visual analytics and performance dashboards.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative environment.
  • Experience with designing, administering, and reporting on data from surveys. Knowledge of social science research methods.
  • Experience with curriculum or instructional design.
  • Experience with a data management platform (e.g., Watermark/Taskstream, TracDat, Anthology/CampusLabs) and survey management tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Survey Monkey).
  • Experience providing program accreditation support (e.g., AACSB, CAEP, SACSCOC, MSCHE) in a higher education setting.
  • Experience using and manipulating data, including familiarity with statistical analysis (e.g., SPSS, SAS) and/or database (e.g., Access, SQL Server) software applications.

Minimum Requirements

Master's degree in higher education or other discipline and a minimum of five years professional experience in academic outcomes assessment and/or institutional assessment and related activities within a higher education setting (preferably institutional research, faculty development, institutional effectiveness, or assessment). Alternatively, as faculty directly overseeing assessment functions or earned doctoral degree. Supervisory experience.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações, encantando consumidores com produtos de qualidade e sustentabilidade. São mais de 150 anos desde a sua fundação, e a marca sempre tem valores sólidos e atenção às necessidades do tempo. Ela cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder sua essência.

Em 1930, a Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Essa tradição, aliada ao conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, impulsionou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas no mercado brasileiro, tornando‑se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza equilíbrio e consumo consciente, em 2024 a Care se uniu ao Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

A nossa história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Juntos, Granado, Phebo e Care representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando consumidores a viver jornadas únicas de bem‑estar e beleza responsável.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, APIs, and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI, LangChain);
  • Knowledge of data protection and compliance standards for AI systems (GDPR, zero-data retention, PII anonymization);

NICE TO HAVES

description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the Investments Business Unit.

The Opportunity

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What We Have To Offer

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.
  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems: design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.
  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.
  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain: help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.
  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.
  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility: roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote‑friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments
description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer | Investments

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineerto join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

description:
Job Title: WirelessDomain Architect (Arista focused)

Location: Brazil (Must be located in Brazil)

Role: 90 Day Contract to Hire (Potential to convert from Contract to Full Time Employee with benefits)

Position Overview

The Wireless Domain Architect is a senior, hands‑on technical leadership role within a professional IT services organization, serving as the technical authority for enterprise wireless architecture . This position demands expertise in Arista’s next-generation wireless platforms , with demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and supporting Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi and CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) solutions.

The role blends solution design, field deployment leadership, pre‑sales technical scoping, and escalation support , operating as both an architect and hands‑on technical mentor to delivery teams.

Core Responsibilities

Wireless Architecture & Design

  • Serve as the primary wireless domain expert , with deep, hands‑on experience in Arista Wireless architecture, hardware, and cloud‑managed technologies .

  • Design enterprise‑grade wireless solutions leveraging Arista’s cognitive networking capabilities, including:

    • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management, orchestration, and AI/ML‑driven automation planes.

    • Cognitive Wi‑Fi platforms that provide data‑driven telemetry, real‑time analytics, and automatic optimization of wireless connections as network conditions evolve.

    • Multi‑radio, multifunction AP deployments with support for cutting‑edge standards such as Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi‑Fi 7 , zero‑touch onboarding, and high‑density coverage models.

  • Develop high‑level and low‑level wireless designs (HLDs/LLDs) incorporating:

    • RF design, capacity planning, AP placement, and cognitive tuning mechanisms.

    • Zero Trust and WIPS security configurations integrated with cloud orchestration.

    • Flexible data path options and scalable control‑plane architectures inherent to CloudVision’s cognitive approach.

Deployment Leadership & Technical Execution

  • Lead and direct wireless deployment efforts in customer environments and ensure alignment to Arista cognitive design principles .

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers through:

    • Zero‑touch provisioning and onboarding of Arista AP platforms via CV-CUE .

    • Implementation of AI/ML‑enabled analytics and automated remediation features.

    • Integration of AP connectivity with hosted identity management and external NAC solutions.

  • Validate configurations and deployments to ensure stable, optimized performance across cognitive AP platforms and centralized CloudVision management.

Pre‑Sales Scoping & Technical Support

  • Participate in pre‑sales scoping calls with sales and delivery leadership.

  • Provide detailed input on:

    • The effort required to transition customers from legacy Wi‑Fi environments to Arista, Cisco, Aruba and other OEM's or managed architectures .

    • Level of Effort (LOE) estimation for discovery, design, deployment, optimization, and cutover phases.

  • Validate technical assumptions for proposals and SOWs based on real experience with Arista cloud‑native wireless technologies.

Escalation & Customer Assurance

  • Serve as the escalation point for delivery issues related to:

    • Wi‑Fi behavior under load and real‑world spectrum conditions.

    • Automation orchestration failures or troubleshooting of AI/ML‑driven recommendations.

    • Cross‑domain issues spanning wired/wireless convergence and identity enforcement.

  • Engage directly in customer escalation calls to remediate issues, restore confidence, and guide recovery.

Required Technical Expertise (Priority Order)

  • Arista Wireless – REQUIRED / NON‑NEGOTIABLE

    • Hands‑on design, deployment, and operational experience with:

      • Arista Cognitive Wi‑Fi access point platforms (Wi‑Fi 6/6E/7).

      • CloudVision Cognitive Unified Edge (CV-CUE) centralized management and cognitive analytics.

      • AI/ML‑driven automation, telemetry, and troubleshooting inherent to Arista cognitive networking.

  • HPE Aruba Wireless

    • Enterprise Aruba wireless design and deployment experience.

  • Juniper Wireless

    • Familiarity with Juniper Mist and related wireless platforms.

  • Cisco Wireless

    • Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless architectures.

  • Nile Wireless

    • Exposure to or hands‑on experience with Nile wireless solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Track record of enterprise wireless design and deployment , with at least the majority of experience on Arista cognitive wireless solutions .

  • Demonstrable ability to lead design and delivery teams and mentor engineers in real time.

  • Communication skills to interact confidently with technical and executive stakeholders .

  • Ability to balance design, deployment, and escalation responsibilities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in IT professional services or consulting.

  • Multi‑vendor wireless migration expertise.

  • Wireless certifications, particularly with Arista technologies.

  • Experience developing technical scoping documentation, proposals, and LOE estimates.

Role Characteristics

  • Combination of technical leadership, hands‑on execution, pre‑sales engagement, and post‑deployment escalation support .

  • Acts as the architectural authority for Arista wireless engagements.

  • Expected to deliver high‑quality outcomes while transferring knowledge to delivery teams.

Right now, we are entering an exciting growth phase. We’ve just signed a major new project for a large-scale client, which means we are expanding our team. As one of our engineers, you will be tackling fresh challenges, solving interesting architectural puzzles, and scaling our impact. If you like it when things are moving forward and there are real problems to solve, you’ll feel right at home here.

What will you actually do? We follow a "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy. In your day-to-day:

  • .NET / .NET Core and Vue / TypeScript.
  • Azure DevOps and the "CI/CD way of thinking."

Why join us?

  • Real Impact: You’re building software that improves society’s wellbeing.

  • Growth: A clear budget for self-learning and space to share knowledge within our tech communities.

title: Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)
description:
Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security)

Department: Safety & Security

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Non-Competition Sites (Safety & Security) is responsible for planning, coordinating and overseeing safety and security operations across all official non-competition sites for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes hotels, team base camps, training sites, transport hubs, the International Broadcast Centre (IBC) and other designated locations.

The role ensures that robust physical and staffed security measures are designed and implemented in line with identified risks and FIFA standards. The position leads integrated security planning for team and referee operations outside stadium environments and oversees secure movements between official sites. The Manager provides direct leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and relevant Venue Safety & Security Managers assigned to non-competition locations, ensuring consistency, compliance and operational excellence across all sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the integrated safety and security planning for all official non-competition sites, including hotels, team base camps, training facilities, transport hubs, the IBC and other designated locations
  • Develop scalable security concepts tailored to diverse site types and operational risk profiles, including transport security considerations
  • Plan and oversee robust physical security systems and infrastructure, including perimeters, access control, asset protection, search and screening operations
  • Plan and oversee staffed safety and security measures, including security guards, stewards and other deployed personnel
  • Lead the planning and implementation of team and referee security protocols at non-competition sites, including oversight of secure movements between sites and stadiums
  • Provide direct line management and leadership to the Team Security Manager, TSLOs/RSLOs and designated Venue Safety & Security Managers, ensuring clear reporting lines and operational accountability
  • Coordinate centrally with host cities, public security agencies and site counterparts to ensure integrated planning and consistent operational delivery
  • Collaborate with relevant domestic agencies and FIFA functions (e.g. medical, venue management, transport) to develop integrated emergency response, contingency and crisis management plans
  • Develop and implement standardised policies and procedures to ensure consistent safety and security operations across all non-competition sites
  • Ensure alignment between safety and security services outlined in rental or contractual agreements and the operational delivery model; establish clear audit and performance monitoring mechanisms
  • Manage relationships with security suppliers, conduct readiness activities and monitor performance against contractual obligations and service levels
  • Oversee invoicing and verification processes for safety and security suppliers in coordination with finance and administrative teams
  • Ensure compliance with statutory and organisational instruments and relevant FIFA regulations, including the FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations (where applicable)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, public safety, event management, law enforcement or a related field
  • Advanced training in protective security, risk management or operational planning is desirable

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security planning and operational delivery, preferably within major sporting events or multi-site environments
  • Proven experience in leading teams and managing personnel in operational environments
  • Demonstrated experience in secure movement planning, team protection or protective security operations
  • Experience working with public security authorities, private security providers and venue operators in Brazil
  • Experience managing supplier contracts and monitoring service delivery

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and line management capability, with the ability to guide, motivate and oversee multiple operational managers
  • Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills across diverse site environments
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage complex, dynamic operational environments and make decisions under pressure
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including structured reporting
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written) is essential
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Overview

We are seeking a Financial Auditor to join Internal Auditing Organization.

The Internal Auditing is responsible for helping organizations to accomplish their objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes.

Your primary role will be to lead and oversee the audit team while serving as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring strong relationships and high-quality delivery throughout the engagement.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Review and analyze financial statements in order to identify areas which should be assessed as a part of an audit.
  • Design, execute, document and report on audit testing of financial and reporting processes, balances, amounts and disclosures.
  • Identify key business, financial and functional processes for identifying and assessing current and emerging risks.
  • Plan, execute, and/or report internal audits to management.
  • Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.
  • Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.
  • Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.
  • Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.
  • Prepare or assist in preparing audit reports.
  • Deliver presentations to client’s management at the audit opening and closing meetings.
  • Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to inexperienced or less experienced staff.
  • Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance or another related field. An advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 6 years of experience working either in external auditing and public accounting firms in the auditing/assurance practice or the financial reporting function of a publicly listed company, working with the adoption, application and presentation of International Financial Reporting Standards.
  • You should hold a Certified Public Accountant or Chartered Accountant designation. Additional certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor is a plus.
  • You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

description:
Descrição Sumária

INSCRIÇÕES ABERTAS – até 30/03/2026. O prazo poderá ser alterado sem aviso prévio.

  • O profissional atuará na área operacional de um projeto ou de uma proposta, incorporado no PMT, e será responsável por coordenar as atividades de planejamento de projetos de alta complexidade, estabelecendo interfaces estratégicas com o cliente, fornecedores e demais membros do time de projeto.
  • É esperado que este (a) profissional execute as atividades com robusto domínio das ferramentas de planejamento e do escopo de projetos EPCI.
  • Dentro do projeto se reportará ao “Gerente de Controle de Projeto”, dependendo do tipo de projeto; e funcionalmente ao “Gerente de Planejamento” e ficará locado no Escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

Desenvolver e conduzir, desde o estágio inicial, o cronograma de projetos EPCI complexos na fase de BID, estruturando WBS, considerando restrições contratuais, folgas estratégicas, simulações e cenários alternativos, com autonomia, confidencialidade e alinhamento às regras corporativas. Implementar a WBS do projeto e analisar documentação de propostas e contratos, emitindo os documentos de planejamento conforme requisitos.

Realizar análise crítica aplicando a metodologia CPM, propondo soluções quando necessário. Garantir que mudanças do BID ou do contrato sejam refletidas e avaliadas no cronograma, permitindo identificar possíveis Variation Orders do cliente. Desenvolver análises de cenário considerando diferentes layouts submarinos e sequenciamentos operacionais, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Gerenciar no cronograma o planejamento de fornecedores e subcontratados, definindo metodologia de medição de progresso de acordo com exigências contratuais. Manter comunicação eficaz com fornecedores, subcontratados e equipes internas, consolidando o cronograma do BID ou do projeto. Acompanhar pacotes de fabricação dos equipamentos para garantir consistência entre os cronogramas.

Construir, junto ao cliente, o cronograma Baseline do projeto e realizar eventuais re-baselines ao longo do avanço. Garantir integração entre Project Controllers, Package Managers e Contract Managers, assegurando qualidade das entregas. Identificar riscos e oportunidades relacionadas ao planejamento.

Coletar e inserir dados de progresso no cronograma, avaliando impactos conforme métodos definidos em contrato. Gerenciar mudanças de escopo, correções e impactos no planejamento, em colaboração com o Project Controls Manager. Orientar e apoiar Analistas de Planejamento em diferentes níveis, atuando como referência técnica. Assegurar a aplicação dos padrões de planejamento da Subsea 7 e disseminar conhecimento da disciplina na organização.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Domínio de Primavera P6 e MS Project.
  • Power BI avançado.
  • Noções sólidas de gestão e planejamento de projetos.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Primavera Risk Analysis e Crystal Ball.
  • Noções do módulo de planejamento do ProArc.

Formação

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia (ciências exatas). Desejável.

Experiência

Desejável experiência mínima de 8 anos em Planejamento de Projetos. Capacidade de elaborar planos de ação sempre que necessário.

Valorizamos a diversidade e entendemos as diferenças como oportunidades. Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas.

  • Solid understanding of distributed system architecture focusing on availability, reliability and performance;
  • Strong focus on execution and delivery of the product;
  • Exceptional attention to detail and focus on quality and long-term goals;
  • Strong communication skills;
  • A demonstrated ability to provide guidance, mentorship, and support;
  • A leadership mindset;
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where learning and adaptability are key;

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.

  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

description:
A Share People Hub, em parceria com o Instituto Clima e Sociedade (ICS), está buscando Especialista em Economia e Clima com atuação híbrida no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília.

Desafios da Posição

A Pessoa Especialista será responsável pela identificação e articulação de parceiros e donatários, acompanhamento técnico das iniciativas e leitura política qualificada, contribuindo para consolidar o ecossistema nacional de Economia e Clima.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar, sob a liderança da Gestão de Políticas Climáticas, na consolidação da agenda de Economia e Clima do iCS, garantindo coerência entre estratégia institucional, portfólio apoiado e metas relacionadas à incorporação da agenda climática nas decisões econômicas estruturantes do país.
  • Coordenar e qualificar a atuação do iCS na temática de mercado de carbono, acompanhando o processo regulatório, articulando parceiros estratégicos, promovendo alinhamentos técnicos entre mercado regulado e voluntário e apoiando a consolidação de um ecossistema institucional com governança robusta e previsibilidade regulatória.
  • Estruturar e gerir parcerias voltadas ao desenvolvimento e incidência em instrumentos econômicos, fiscais e tributários para a transição climática, incluindo precificação de carbono, mecanismos redistributivos e integração de critérios climáticos ao planejamento econômico.
  • Articular e fortalecer centros de pesquisa, think tanks e organizações estratégicas para ampliar a produção qualificada de análises econômicas sobre clima, assegurando alinhamento técnico, sinergia entre iniciativas apoiadas e foco em impacto regulatório e institucional.
  • Coordenar o acompanhamento técnico de estudos e projetos desenvolvidos por donatários e consultores, garantindo aderência às prioridades estratégicas do eixo, consistência metodológica e potencial de incidência nas políticas públicas.
  • Atuar na mobilização de financiamento verde, apoiando iniciativas que fortaleçam instrumentos financeiros públicos e privados, ampliem a alavancagem de capital para mitigação e adaptação e integrem critérios climáticos ao sistema financeiro e orçamentário.
  • Mapear e engajar atores governamentais, setor privado, sistema de justiça e sociedade civil para promover integração federativa e cooperação multissetorial na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Apoiar a definição de posicionamentos institucionais do iCS em debates estratégicos como reforma tributária, instrumentos financeiros públicos, planos de desenvolvimento e políticas econômicas com impacto climático.
  • Facilitar espaços técnicos de diálogo e articulação entre parceiros, promovendo convergência de agendas e construção de consensos qualificados.
  • Avaliar tecnicamente propostas de apoio, gerir o ciclo completo de projetos (aprovação, acompanhamento, monitoramento de resultados e reporte), assegurando alinhamento com os outcomes estratégicos do eixo.
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e notas estratégicas para a Diretoria e financiadores, sistematizando avanços, riscos e oportunidades na agenda de Economia e Clima.
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com o cargo, conforme demandas estratégicas do eixo programático.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Ensino superior completo em Economia.
  • Mestrado, doutorado ou especialização relevante em Economia do Clima, Economia Ambiental, Políticas Públicas, Finanças Sustentáveis, Desenvolvimento Econômico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos em economia ambiental ou climática, políticas públicas econômicas ou financiamento sustentável.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos estratégicos, articulação multissetorial e acompanhamento técnico de estudos ou consultorias.
  • Experiência com: contexto do terceiro setor e filantropia, economia do clima, instrumentos econômicos e regulatórios para a transição climática, mercado de carbono, financiamento climático, análise de políticas públicas e gestão de portfólio de projetos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com processos regulatórios e políticas públicas será considerada diferencial.

O que esperamos de você | Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Responsividade, Dinamismo, agilidade, Atitude propositiva, Iniciativa, Trabalho EM e ENTRE equipes, Comprometimento, Criatividade, Atenção aos detalhes, Comunicação assertiva, Solução de problemas, Orientação para Resultados | Organização, Respeito e tolerância a diversidade

Modelo de Contratação

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

title: OCM Senior Analyst – Change, Learning, and Enablement
description:
What Success Looks Like In This Role

Provides consultation and hands‑on support to help leaders, teams, and organizations understand, adopt, and implement change initiatives. Supports the design and delivery of change, learning, and end‑user enablement activities that address resistance, improve adoption, and contribute to successful business outcomes. Focuses on the people side of change related to business process updates, systems and technology implementations, job role changes, and organizational adjustments, with an emphasis on end‑user readiness and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides change management, learning, and end‑user enablement support for defined initiatives and projects under the guidance of more senior practitioners.
  • Supports small to moderately complex change or enablement efforts, contributing to project workstreams as assigned.
  • Assists with change impact and readiness assessments to identify stakeholder needs, learning requirements, and end‑user impacts.
  • Helps identify process improvement opportunities by gathering input, documenting current‑state processes, and supporting future‑state recommendations.
  • Contributes to the identification of potential resistance, adoption risks, and capability gaps, and supports the development of mitigation strategies and enablement tactics.
  • Collaborates with change management team members, project teams, and stakeholders to develop and execute deliverables across:
    • Communications and messaging
    • Sponsorship and leadership support
    • Manager and team coaching materials
    • Learning and training content
    • End‑user enablement and support resources
    • Resistance and adoption management activities
  • Supports the design and delivery of learning assets (e.g., training sessions, job aids, guides, and performance support materials) that help end users adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Assists in facilitating training sessions, workshops, or enablement activities as needed.
  • Provides support to project teams and people leaders by reinforcing change and adoption practices.
  • Helps track adoption, learning effectiveness, and change progress metrics; documents issues, risks, and feedback.
  • Monitors end‑user feedback and adoption trends, escalating concerns and improvement opportunities to senior team members.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives related to technology, process, or business transformation.
  • Exposure to learning design, training delivery, or end‑user enablement activities.
  • Working knowledge of change management and continuous improvement concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create client‑ready deliverables and presentations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, stakeholders, and change colleagues globally.
  • Willingness to learn and grow change, learning, and enablement skills through personal development and hands‑on project experiences.

Additional Qualifications

  • Prosci Change Management Practitioner certification, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or related OCM certification is strongly preferred
  • Experience working across global, multi‑cultural environments is strongly preferred.
  • Multilingual communication skills are a plus
  • Prosci Train‑the‑Trainer Certification is a plus

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About The Role

We are looking for a Data QA Engineer with a strong SQL focus to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and trustworthiness of data-driven systems and analytics products. This role is central to validating business logic, data transformations, and critical reporting pipelines that inform real decisions, while working closely with engineering and data teams. The opportunity stands out for its deep impact on data quality, strong ownership, and growth within a collaborative, automation-oriented environment.

What You Will Do

  • Execute manual and automated tests across APIs, backend pipelines, and analytics outputs;

  • Create and maintain test cases, test plans, and execution reports using Jira/TestRail or similar tools;

  • Support automation efforts by creating or updating API test scripts and regression suites;

MUST HAVES

  • Ability to analyze functional requirements and propose test scenarios and edge cases;

NICE TO HAVES

  • Backend automation experience using Python-based frameworks;
  • Understanding of data processing, ETL, or large-scale ingestion pipelines;
  • Previous exposure to healthcare, pharma, or analytics data.

Perks And Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization’s cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization’s digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICs, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICs).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICs.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high‑performance, employee‑centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.

  • Talent Acquisition, development & mobility
    • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
    • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
    • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
    • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high‑performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction and long‑term retention.
  • Performance management & organizational development
    • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management and leadership development strategies.
    • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
    • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data‑driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.

  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast‑paced environment.

Responsabilidades Da Posição

O(a) Recepcionista será o primeiro ponto de contato dos pacientes e famílias na clínica, sendo responsável por proporcionar uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e humanizada desde o momento da chegada até o término do atendimento. Essa pessoa atuará em um ambiente com grande fluxo de pacientes e atendimentos por diversos planos de saúde, e terá papel essencial na organização do fluxo de agendamentos e documentação da clínica.

  • Receber e acolher pacientes e acompanhantes, oferecendo atendimento cordial e empático;
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados no sistema da clínica, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas;
  • Fazer agendamentos, remarcações e confirmações de consultas por telefone, WhatsApp e presencialmente;
  • Orientar sobre documentação, autorizações e guias necessárias para os atendimentos;
  • Conferir guias e autorizações de planos de saúde, encaminhando-as corretamente para o setor de faturamento;
  • Organizar e controlar a agenda dos profissionais, mantendo a comunicação clara entre pacientes e equipe técnica;
  • Apoiar na rotina administrativa da recepção, como controle de presença, emissão de recibos e arquivamento de documentos;
  • Manter o ambiente da recepção organizado e acolhedor, refletindo os valores de cuidado e profissionalismo da clínica.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Fisioterapia ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em recepção de clínica ou hospital, preferencialmente com atendimento a convênios de saúde;
  • Vivência com grande volume de atendimentos e rotina dinâmica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão clínica ou prontuário eletrônico;
  • Domínio básico do pacote Office (principalmente Excel e Outlook);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional e empática;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão no preenchimento e conferência de guias;
  • Comprometimento com sigilo e ética profissional, respeitando as informações dos pacientes e os protocolos internos.

Sobre a Empresa

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. Desde 1997, mantém uma sólida parceria com o Jockey Club Brasileiro e, atualmente, está presente em diversas unidades — entre elas, Lagoa, Sociedade Hípica Brasileira e Jacarepaguá. A clínica conta com uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, formada por profissionais de áreas como Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiologia, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Psicopedagogia e Equoterapia. Todos atuam de forma integrada, com foco em um atendimento humanizado, técnico e ético.

E os nossos benefícios?

Para sua saúde e bem-estar

Fundado em 1986 a Ser promove e impulsiona ações voltadas ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento social e cultural. Os colaboradores sócios contam com serviços diferenciados, clube de descontos e vantagens com mais de 200 empresas parceiras nas áreas de educação, saúde, alimentação, lazer e entretenimento. Sobre a Lojas Renner

O que é que te encanta? ❤️ Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos.

Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Seu lugar é aqui.

Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize.

E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?

Quer trabalhar na maior empresa de bikes elétricas do Brasil? Nascemos em 2010, no Rio de Janeiro. A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos. E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana. Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor. Como você leva a sua vida? Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos? A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas. A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido. E por falar em caminho, que ele seja sempre a melhor parte. Muito prazer, nós somos a Lev.

title: Analista de Redes e Infraestrutura Senior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na V.tal, acreditamos que a tecnologia conecta pessoas e transforma o futuro. Somos uma empresa inovadora e focada em excelência, operando com uma cultura dinâmica e colaborativa. Nosso time trabalha com autonomia, paixão e compromisso, sempre em busca dos melhores resultados.

Buscamos um Analista de Redes e Infraestrutura Senior para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável por gerenciar, manter e otimizar nossa complexa arquitetura de rede, garantindo alta disponibilidade, segurança e performance dos nossos serviços. O candidato ideal terá experiência prática com firewalls, roteadores, switches, load balancers e tecnologias de virtualização de rede em ambientes de data center de grande porte. Sua atuação será fundamental para a manutenção da infraestrutura de rede, promovendo a estabilidade e segurança dos nossos sistemas, o que impactará diretamente na continuidade dos serviços e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerenciamento de Firewalls: Configurar, monitorar e manter as políticas de segurança.
  • Segregação de Tráfego com VRFs: Implementar e gerenciar Virtual Routing and Forwarding.
  • Administração de Load Balancers: Gerenciar para garantir distribuição de tráfego e alta disponibilidade.
  • Monitoramento e Troubleshooting: Monitorar a saúde da rede e resolver problemas.
  • Gestão de Endereçamento IP: Administrar ranges de IP (IPv4 e IPv6).
  • Otimizar a arquitetura de rede para garantir alta disponibilidade e performance.
  • Garantir a segurança da rede através de configurações e políticas adequadas.
  • Resolver problemas complexos de conectividade e roteamento de forma eficiente.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada para facilitar futuras manutenções e auditorias.
  • Desenvolver soluções de arquitetura de redes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em configuração de múltiplos fornecedores de Firewalls.
  • Proficiência em protocolos de roteamento (OSPF, BGP) e VLANs.
  • Domínio em VRFs para segregação de tráfego.
  • Domínio em configuração e gerenciamento de Load Balancers.
  • Domínio em TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, VPNs.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de rede.
  • Certificações: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE ou equivalentes (desejável).
  • Experiência com redes em ambientes de nuvem (desejável).
  • Experiência em scripting (Python, Ansible) para automação de redes.
  • Experiência em Zero Trust, IDS/IPS e WAF (desejável).
  • Graduação em Redes de Computadores, Engenharia de Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas.

Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Programa de participação nos resultados (PPR)
  • Auxílio Farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Flexibilidade de horário
  • Clube de Vantagens V.tal
  • Licença maternidade estendida (6 meses)
  • Licença paternidade estendida (20 dias)

Nossa visão

O FUTURO PASSA POR AQUI E É COM VOCÊ QUE IREMOS CONSTRUÍ-LO. Nós somos a V.tal, uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de viabilizar a conexão com o mundo digital transformando a vida das pessoas. Trabalhamos para ajudar a incluir o Brasil no topo da lista dos países mais digitalizados do mundo, promovendo a inclusão digital, impulsionando novos negócios e estimulando o desenvolvimento regional.

E isso é possível porque já nascemos com a maior rede de fibra ótica do Brasil e com um time que faz acontecer. Somos uma rede neutra, compartilhada com operadoras, provedores e parceiros de todos os tamanhos e regiões. E isso nos enche de orgulho. Toda essa robustez nos permite oferecer abrangência e capilaridade para os nossos clientes irem mais longe, otimizando seus investimentos.

Somos conectados, ágeis e direcionados pelo excelente resultado. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve porque é formado por pessoas que colaboram entre si, confiam umas nas outras e vibram por cada conquista. Aqui nós não damos desculpas, buscamos a solução. É com essa equipe de alta performance que trabalhamos diariamente para incluir o Brasil no topo da lista dos países mais digitalizados do mundo, promovendo a inclusão digital, o desenvolvimento econômico e social das pessoas.

Evolução e aprendizado constante é nosso mantra. Sem aprendizado, não há evolução. Somos obcecados pela excelência e alta performance. A busca pelo resultado acontece diariamente em cada decisão. Se identificou com a nossa proposta? Então vem construir o futuro com a gente hoje!

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including: Regional Main , Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in person/online meetings, training events. Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded, and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs identify training needs, effectively reach targeted audiences, and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organizations, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet program quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on project outcomes and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access).
  • Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high‑level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public. Knowledge of creating and managing contracts for vendors, data entry, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently to assist in paperwork for processing of grant funds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business or administration and 3-6 years of experience. Five years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$42,000-52,000

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Suas quatro superintendências – Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação – são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Experiências que realmente nos encantam

  • Vivência com revisões periódicas de acesso, hardening e saneamento de identidades.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975.
